en.hubeali: Muhammad Bin Ahmad, from one of his companions, from Ibrahim Bin Muhammad Al Saqafy, from Ibrahim Bin Yahya Al Sowry, from Haysam Bin Basheer, from Abu Basheer, from Abu Rawh that,

‘A woman resembled herself with a slave girl for a man, and that was at night. So he fell upon her, and he took her for his slave girl. So the matter was raised to Umar. So he sent a messenger to Aliasws, so heasws said: ‘Whip the man a Penalty (Hadd) in the secrecy, and whip the woman a Penalty (Hadd) in the open’.
